summary: Methanex Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing it agreed to sell substantially all of its New Zealand natural gas contractual entitlements, effective Q1 2027 through expiry at decade-end, due to declining domestic gas supply. It will indefinitely idle New Zealand production facilities in Q1 2027, expecting no material cash costs. CEO Rich Sumner noted preserving facilities for potential restart. No price, premium, or advisors disclosed. The deal represents a strategic exit from unsustainable operations, with regulatory and stakeholder transitions to watch; no classic M&A risk-arb, but monitor cost and guidance updates.
